exercise.name: Dumbbell Hang Clean

reference.title: Dumbbell Hang Clean
reference.listing: Video; data sheet: body part Weightlifting, equipment Dumbbell, exercise type Strength

exercise.mechanics: Compound (explosive hip, knee and ankle extension; shrug and pull; catch)

breathing.pattern: Breathe in and brace at the hang, hold the brace through the pull and the catch, breathe out as you stand with the dumbbells on the shoulders.
breathing.cadence: Fast pull and catch (about 0.7 s from the hang to the catch), controlled lowering

prescription.tempo: Explosive pull, stick the catch, lower under control
prescription.load: User-chosen dumbbells light enough to move fast; quality reps, stop well before fatigue slows the pull. For barbell hang cleans Suchomel 2014 found peak power at moderate loads (about 45% of the hang clean 1RM for the high pull).
prescription.frequency: 1-3 times a week, early in the session
prescription.progression: Add load only while the catch stays crisp; then progress to the power clean from the floor

cues.text: Stand tall, feet hip width, dumbbells at your sides with palms facing in.
Push the hips back with a flat back until the dumbbells sit just above the knees.
Jump through the floor: hips, knees and ankles extend, shrug, then pull the elbows high and out.
Turn the elbows forward and catch the dumbbells on the shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand tall with the dumbbells resting on the shoulders.
Lower the dumbbells under control to the sides, bending the knees a little.
Stand tall, reset the grip and the brace.

mistakes.mistake: Pulling with the arms before the hips finish
mistakes.fix: Keep the arms long until the hips and knees have extended, then shrug and pull.

mistakes.mistake: Dumbbells swinging away from the body
mistakes.fix: Keep the dumbbells close, elbows high and out.

mistakes.mistake: Catching with straight legs or a big back bend
mistakes.fix: Drop into a quarter squat with an upright trunk as the dumbbells land.

mistakes.mistake: Rounding the back at the hang
mistakes.fix: Hinge from the hips with the chest up and a flat back.

kinematics.norm: Dumbbells just above the knees, hips back, flat back, shoulders over the dumbbells (NSCA Essentials, hang power clean)
Hips, knees and ankles extend, the heels may lift, then shrug; elbows stay straight until the extension is complete (NSCA Essentials)
Quarter squat with an upright trunk, elbows forward (NSCA Essentials)
Explosive pull and catch; controlled lowering (clinical opinion)

sources.title: GymVisual #444912, Dumbbell Hang Clean, video (movement reference)

Caulfield, Hornsby & Haff, power exercises: power clean (and hang power clean variation), excerpt from NSCA Essentials of Strength Training and Conditioning, 5th edition (Haff & Triplett, eds.; Human Kinetics)
Suchomel, Wright, Kernozek & Kline 2014, kinetic comparison of the power development between power clean variations (J Strength Cond Res 28(2):350-360)

cautions: Stop if sharp pain, numbness, tingling or giving-way occurs.
The dumbbell load is your choice: pick a weight you can move with the form shown for every rep.
Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.
Fast lifts: learn the positions slowly with a light dumbbell first, keep the dumbbells close to the body and clear a space around you.
Low-back pain: keep the hinge at the hang short and the back flat; skip the lift if pain persists.
modify: Wrist or shoulder discomfort in the rack: rest the dumbbells lightly on the shoulders or stop at the high pull.
Limited hinge: start from a higher hang (mid-thigh).
regressions: Dumbbell high pull from the hang.
Dumbbell Romanian deadlift to learn the hinge.
progressions: Dumbbell power clean from the floor.

muscleNotes.glute_max_r: Drive the explosive hip extension of the second pull, then help absorb the catch.
muscleNotes.glute_max_l: Drive the explosive hip extension of the second pull, then help absorb the catch.
muscleNotes.quads_r: Extend the knees in the drive and absorb the dumbbells in the quarter-squat catch.
muscleNotes.quads_l: Extend the knees in the drive and absorb the dumbbells in the quarter-squat catch.
muscleNotes.hamstrings_r: Hold the hinge at the hang and extend the hips with the glutes.
muscleNotes.hamstrings_l: Hold the hinge at the hang and extend the hips with the glutes.
muscleNotes.calves_r: Rise onto the balls of the feet at the top of the extension (the heels may lift, NSCA Essentials).
muscleNotes.calves_l: Rise onto the balls of the feet at the top of the extension (the heels may lift, NSCA Essentials).
muscleNotes.upper_traps_r: Shrug the shoulders up at the end of the extension, before the elbows bend.
muscleNotes.upper_traps_l: Shrug the shoulders up at the end of the extension, before the elbows bend.
muscleNotes.lat_deltoid_r: Lift the elbows high and out in the pull.
muscleNotes.lat_deltoid_l: Lift the elbows high and out in the pull.
muscleNotes.ant_deltoid_r: Turn the elbows forward and up into the rack position.
muscleNotes.ant_deltoid_l: Turn the elbows forward and up into the rack position.
muscleNotes.biceps_r: Bend the elbows as the dumbbells are pulled up and turned over; control the lowering.
muscleNotes.biceps_l: Bend the elbows as the dumbbells are pulled up and turned over; control the lowering.
muscleNotes.forearm_flexors_r: Grip the handles through the pull and the catch.
muscleNotes.forearm_flexors_l: Grip the handles through the pull and the catch.
muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_r: Hold a flat back at the hang and through the drive.
muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_l: Hold a flat back at the hang and through the drive.
muscleNotes.core: Brace before the drive and stay braced in the catch.
